newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Redfire in Gawler Craton farm-in pact.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Redfire in Gawler Craton farm-in pact.

text.p: Redfire Resources NL said on Tuesday it has entered into a farm-in agreement with Coombedown Resources NL covering four exploration gold mine tenements, together with option agreements to acquire a majority of the shares in Coombedown.

Through the farm-in agreement, Redfire said it can earn an 80 percent interest on the metallic minerals and precious metals contained in four exploration licences by spending A$1 million on the properties.
The licences are located at Glendambo in the central portion of the highly prospective Gawler Craton region of South Australia and cover an area of 5,221 square kilometres.
Redfire said it now holds interests in 11 exploration titles across the Gawler Craton totaling more than 14,000 square kilometres.
The interests are located in areas with prospects that range from untested targets to identified zones of gold mineralisation, it said.

Redfire also said option agreements have been signed with shareholders of Coombedown giving Redfire the right to acquire 66.7 percent of Coombedown for A$167,000 and 800,000 Redfire shares on or before March 24, 1998 or within 14 days of a decision to mine, whichever occurs first.
